Hi Marta — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can get you the evidence you asked for: 

1) You asked for a SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and a short bridge letter to cover the gap until the latest report is public. We can share our 2027 Type II and a bridge letter.
2) You mentioned you prefer evidence via a trust portal (read-only) rather than attaching sensitive artifacts to email. We can provision a temporary TrustPortal link scoped to Greenleaf.
3) You also asked for the vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) to be filled — if you send the file we can populate answers and return a redline.

Proposed owners and timelines:
- I will coordinate the SOC2/bridge letter delivery and portal invite (ETA: by end of day tomorrow).
- Jordan Blake will handle contract/PO questions and any redlines.
- Ben Carter (cc'd) will send the TrustPortal invite and a one-time access link scoped to your IP range.

Next steps for you: please share the VSQ file and any specific controls you want evidence for (HIPAA/GDPR concerns noted). Also confirm whether procurement needs a separate email.

Thanks — I'll circle back once the portal invite is issued.

Best,

- Jordan will follow up on procurement/PO language and route if DocuSign is needed.
